user_saw: Nothing reported; only synthetic long malformed outbound text with many unfinished `@[` markers could stall Teams formatting.
summary: Replaced the unanchored Teams mention regex in buildMSTeamsMessageActivity with a single forward scan so malformed `@[` text is parsed in linear time.
reasoning: The quadratic behavior is inherent to the unanchored mention regex from before the graft (`/@\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g`, also quadratic on unclosed `@[`), and a96e6b7b1ad4 / 567bc76209e0 only changed escaping and moved the code, so no commit made it slower. The PR cites synthetic 32,000-repeat hostile inputs and no user report or issue, so this is performance hardening against pathological input rather than a reported defect.
